# PerformX — Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition Agency

## About
PerformX is a performance marketing and customer acquisition agency based in India.
We build complete customer acquisition systems — connecting creative, paid media, 
landing pages, conversion optimisation, tracking, CRM, and automation into a 
single measurable system.

## Positioning
Core statement: "We don't run ads. We build profitable customer acquisition systems."
Tagline: "Performance That Scales"

## Core Services
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram advertising)
- Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max)
- TikTok Ads
- LinkedIn Ads
- Paid Media Strategy
- Performance Creative & UGC
- AI-Powered Video & Creative Production
- Landing Pages & CRO
- Tracking & Analytics
- CRM & Marketing Automation
- Email Marketing & Retention
- WhatsApp Marketing & Automation
